children: : Prices for meat, poultry, fish, and dairy products experienced varied movements on Sunday, October 11, 2026, according to the Information and Decision Support Center (IDSC).
The price of meat increased by 1% daily to EGP 448.9 per kilogram, while the white poultry jumped by 1.5% to EGP 88.2 per kilogram.
Tilapia fish was priced at EGP 84.9 per kilogram, a decline of 3.4% daily.
Regarding dairy products, the price of a liter of packaged milk rose by 1% to EGP 46.6.
A carton of white eggs stood at EGP 119.5 per kilogram, an increase of 4.7% daily.

title: ZAWYA: Egypt: Poultry, meat, dairy products climb on October 11
